notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {1}.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}.
Repeat.
